verified.against: National Academies DRI summary table PDFs (RDA and AI for vitamins, elements, water and macronutrients; upper limits; chronic disease risk reduction; macronutrient ranges) and Dietary Guidelines for Americans 2020-2025, Appendix 2

sources.title: Protein and Amino Acid Requirements in Human Nutrition

notes: Upper limits for magnesium, niacin, folate and vitamin E apply to supplements and fortificants only, so they are not applied to food.
The vitamin A upper limit applies to preformed vitamin A (retinol), not to carotenes from plants.
Adults over 50 are advised to get most vitamin B12 from fortified foods or supplements.
